Hotfix release, the first one published from [ops-software/mini-oled-dock](https://github.com/ops-software/mini-oled-dock). The fix comes from [PR #1](https://github.com/ops-software/mini-oled-dock/pull/1) by [VanheXen](https://github.com/VanheXen). Thanks!

### Fixes

- **Start menu search ignoring what you type**. Opening Start (Start button or Win double tap) made the popup the active window, but no window in it had keyboard focus: typed letters were handled as system shortcuts and never reached the search box. It happened every time right after the dock started, and from time to time afterwards. The popup now takes keyboard focus when it is activated (this applies to every dock popup).
- **Popups that do not come to the front**. When Windows refuses to bring a popup to the front, the dock now checks it and tries again, up to 6 times every 80 ms, as long as you have not switched to another window. The attempts are written to the log (`foreground variant` and `popup: foreground retry` lines).

No new options, no config changes.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, copies itself to `%ProgramFiles%\mini-oled-dock` and starts with Windows. To update, run `--install` from the new `dock.exe`: the running dock is stopped and restarted from the new copy. Settings are kept.

### Known limitations

Same as [1.3.0](https://github.com/ops-software/mini-oled-dock/releases/tag/v1.3.0).
